records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Harbor Collective!
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for setting up Harbor Collective on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Next step after your welcome call
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Glad the CSV export is lined up with the dashboard now — that ticket is closed on our side, so do shout if anything still looks off.

Since our welcome call, you've got your first project set up, which is the main thing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The piece that usually makes the difference next is getting your team in alongside you — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk you through that on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
